title: EVN Open car practice · Level 1: One lap, a crossing, a sign, a cone
brief: Practice for the EVN Open capstone's option A (G12.4: an autonomous car), never a capstone level: a team's level is witnessed on its own track. A closed track of 6.57 m with two bends (300 mm lane, black lines), one lap from the start line. A pedestrian crossing at x 2100 on the lower straight: a person (a 200 mm cylinder) walks y 200..1740 across the road and back at 150 mm/s, waits while the robot is within 250 mm of its next step and turns back after 2 s; its start is drawn each run. Yield before it: aim your front at x 1600 at most and let it come to rest short of x 1750 (there the person never waits for you), and go when it has crossed your path and moved away - a forward distance sensor sees it only about 140 mm either side of your centre line, and a breach counts out to 349 mm. A stop sign stands by the upper straight at x 1550; its stop zone is x 1600..1850 on the lane (the sign is a print a camera reads; the class robot has none, so its place is given here - a stand-in until LINK). One cone (50 mm, loose) on the upper straight, 100 mm off the centre: red, keep it on your left (it lies left of the centre); green, on your right; its place and colour are in cone.json ([[mm along the lane, colour]], a stand-in for a camera), along the lane's centre line from (1000, 1000), east along the lower straight first. The lap's clock runs from the start line (300 mm along, x 1300) to its next crossing; a departure is a wheel's middle over a line (a wheel held outside the lane counts one more each second). The course fixes one example set of approved requirements. R1 (headline): one lap (at most 3 departures). R2 (safety): never touch the person or pass within 150 mm of it, never touch a wall. R3: the lap within 60 s (driving at 0.2 m/s takes 33 s; the lap time counts the stop and the wait too). R4 (sign): stand still (under 5 mm/s) with the middle of your axle in the stop zone for 1 s - stop 2 s to be sure. R5 (obstacle): the lap, and the cone passed on its side and not knocked. A run that breaks R2 scores 0 and fails the level, whatever else it did; any other run scores 20 for each requirement it meets. A requirement is met over the level when it holds on at least 80 % of the runs (R2 on every run). Level 1: five runs from the start box (+-10 mm, +-2 deg); the cone at 4400 mm along. Pass: no run breaks R2, R1 is met, and at least three of the five requirements are met (60 %). cone.json for practice (seed 0): [[4400, "red"]]. Par: 29 s.

score.run: if(personBreach | touchesOf_wallW + touchesOf_wallE + touchesOf_wallS + touchesOf_wallN > 0, 0, 20 + if(finished, 20, 0) + if(finished & lapTime <= tmax, 20, 0) + if(visitTime_1 >= 0, 20, 0) + if(finished & conesWrong + conesKnocked == 0, 20, 0))

breaches.value: count(r in runs: r.personBreach | r.touchesOf_wallW + r.touchesOf_wallE + r.touchesOf_wallS + r.touchesOf_wallN > 0)

inTime.value: count(r in runs: r.finished & r.lapTime <= tmax)

cone.value: count(r in runs: r.finished & r.conesWrong + r.conesKnocked == 0)
